question: What fractional divisions are allowed as alternatives in the measurement scheme?
premises: A one-fifth division is an option.
A subdivision of the fire-part is an option.
inference: It may be one part in five, or a subdivision of the fire-part.
uncertainties: The exact parsing of agnyaṃśeṃśam is uncertain.
plain_english: It may be one part in five, or else a subdivision of the fire-part.
